description: This file implements a PHP class ADODB_db2 which is a database driver for IBM DB2, providing connection handling, query execution, transaction management, and metadata functions specific to DB2, as part of the ADODB database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB_db2
classes.description: Main class implementing the ADODB database driver for DB2, managing connections, queries, transactions, and metadata.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_db2
classes.description: Class representing record set results retrieved from DB2 queries, with methods for navigating and fetching data.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a DB2 database using provided DSN, username, and password.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to a DB2 database.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message generated by DB2 extension functions.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code reported by DB2 extension functions.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, returning a statement handle or SQL string.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with optional input parameters, handling errors and storing result info.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB column in a table with given binary data.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows from the last operation.
